articles.title: Office furniture, tea packets used to conceal drugs in Assam, Mizoram; 50 kg meth
articles.summary: DRI uncovers unusual smuggling methods in two operations; four arrested, three vehicles seized Guwahati, October 30 : Drug smugglers are using everyday goods to conceal narcotics while moving consignments through the Northeast. In two back-to-back operations in Assam and Mizoram, the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) recovered 50 kg of methamphetamine hidden inside an office table and tea packets.

articles.title: Mumbai Police Arrest Twelfth Suspect in Tiger Shroff Firing Case
